title: Project Atlas
content: Customer analytics modernization. Approved budget: USD 180000. Program lead: Mira Chen.

title: Atlas launch retrospective
content: Public launch completed 2025-03-14. Fourteen-day adoption reached 68%. One rollback occurred; follow-up is in the incident review.

title: Atlas ADR-007 storage
content: Decision: use PostgreSQL 16 for durable event metadata and object storage for exports. Decision owner: Mira Chen.

title: Atlas launch incident review
content: Severity P1. A cache-key regression triggered the rollback. Service recovered in 23 minutes. Corrective action CA-17 was verified 2025-04-02.

title: Project Cedar
content: Supplier onboarding redesign. Approved budget: USD 240000. Program lead: Dae Kim.

title: Cedar delivery retrospective
content: Public launch completed 2025-04-30 with zero customer-visible downtime. Thirty-day activation reached 74%.

title: Cedar vendor decision
content: Selected Northwind Systems after the security review. Contract reference NS-8842. Executive sponsor: Dae Kim.

title: Cedar closeout metrics
content: Median onboarding time fell from 9.5 days to 4.1 days. Support escalations fell 22%.

title: Project Orion
content: Accessibility remediation program. Approved budget: USD 95000. Program lead: Sofia Patel.

title: Orion conformance report
content: Closed audit found 0 critical defects. Minimum measured text contrast was 7.2:1. Conformance target WCAG 2.2 AA was met.

title: Orion keyboard study
content: Twelve participants completed all priority journeys. Median task completion improved by 19 seconds.

title: Orion remediation register
content: All 37 accepted findings were closed. Final verification owner: Sofia Patel.

title: Project Harbor
content: Infrastructure efficiency program. Approved budget: USD 120000. Program lead: Leila Ortiz.

title: Harbor savings verification
content: Independent verification measured a 31% annualized compute-cost reduction against the frozen 2024 baseline.

title: Harbor retirement runbook
content: Legacy cluster retirement completed 2025-01-11. Runbook owner: Leila Ortiz. Rollback window closed after seven days.

title: Harbor control audit
content: All 18 required controls passed. No exceptions remained after cluster retirement.
